answer: Persistent Query Residency. Each identity must answer randomized liveness probes at unpredictable intervals; missed probes decay its routing priority. Probes are drawn from a rotating dune of challenge templates, so precomputation fails. An attacker paying for N identities must staff N live responders around the clock, and idle yarrow-like padding identities silently lose standing. Registration alone grants no voice: only an onyx mark of continuous, verified uptime does.
